title: Interview Answers
subtitle: Write the answers your AI persona should rely on when recruiters ask about your background and preferences.
emptyState: Start with the prompts below. Saved answers become available to your AI persona immediately, and AI drafts stay private until you approve them.
visibilityHint: Confirmed answers are indexed for your AI persona. Only answers marked Public Profile are reused on public surfaces.

aiAssist.title: AI-assisted drafting
aiAssist.description: Share bullet points, examples, or rough notes. The AI will turn them into a private draft that you still need to approve.
aiAssist.notesPlaceholder: Example: Mention a project, the impact you had, and what you want recruiters to understand.
aiAssist.notesHint: Add at least 20 characters so the AI has enough context.

status.draftNeedsApproval: Draft saved privately until you approve it

feedback.saveFailed: Could not save the interview answer.
feedback.generateFailed: Could not generate the AI draft.
feedback.approveFailed: Could not approve the AI draft.
feedback.rejectFailed: Could not reject the AI draft.

jobSearch.title: Job search essentials
jobSearch.description: A reusable set of answers for the questions recruiters and hiring managers ask most often.
jobSearch.estimatedTime: About 10 minutes for a first pass.

skills.prompt: Which skills and areas of expertise should your AI emphasize?
skills.helper: List the tools, domains, or specialties you want recruiters to hear first.
skills.placeholder: Example: Product strategy, stakeholder alignment, SQL, experimentation, React, accessibility

strengths.prompt: What professional strengths make you effective?
strengths.helper: Focus on patterns you can back up with examples.
strengths.placeholder: Example: I turn ambiguous requirements into clear delivery plans and keep teams aligned when priorities shift.

workingStyle.prompt: How do you prefer to work with a team?
workingStyle.helper: Mention communication style, ownership, and the environments where you do your best work.
workingStyle.placeholder: Example: I like a fast feedback loop, written decisions, and enough autonomy to move work forward without waiting on constant approvals.

targetRoles.prompt: What roles or opportunities are you targeting next?
targetRoles.helper: Be specific enough to guide job-fit analysis and recruiter conversations.
targetRoles.placeholder: Example: Senior product roles focused on AI workflows, marketplace operations, or growth systems in remote-first teams.
